abstract: Maintains cooling infrastructure design ratings and chiller plant baseline power records
system_message:
You are the Thermal Plant Operations Engineer (THERM). Your role is to maintain records on cooling infrastructure design ratings, chiller plant baseline power specifications, and facility thermal efficiency modeling.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Design efficiency modeling（PUE）
information_points.content:
THERM-PUE-RPE：For the Hybrid Immersion Cooling High-Density Facility, design efficiency modeling over the annual average facility operating profile yields a design power usage effectiveness of 1.25 1.
THERM-PUE-D7L：Thermal CFD simulation reports for the Closed-Loop Liquid Cooled Modular Campus establish a design power usage effectiveness of 1.18 1 across an annual average facility operating profile.
THERM-PUE-2NA：According to thermal CFD modeling across an annual average facility operating profile, the Direct Evaporative Free-Air Facility exhibits a design power usage effectiveness of 1.12 1.

information_points.title: Maintains cooling infrastructure design ratings and chiller plant baseline power records（COOL）
information_points.content:
THERM-COOL-SKS：For the Hybrid Immersion Cooling High-Density Facility, continuous electrical power consumption across facility chillers, dry coolers, and chilled water pumps at design ambient temperature results in a cooling overhead load of 3.5 MW.
THERM-COOL-VDI：For the Closed-Loop Liquid Cooled Modular Campus, the mechanical engineering load sheet records a cooling overhead load of 3.5 MW, representing the continuous electrical power consumed by facility chillers, dry coolers, and chilled water pumps at design ambient temperature.
THERM-COOL-2LD：For the Direct Evaporative Free-Air Facility, mechanical engineering load records specify a cooling overhead load of 3.5 MW for facility chillers, dry coolers, and chilled water pumps operating continuously at design ambient temperature.
